label: Sonnets of Messer Gasparo Visconti
variants: the sonnets of Messer Gasparo Visconti
summary: Poems by the Milanese court poet Gasparo Visconti, a friend of Leonardo.

claims.statement: Entered as no. 29 in the reconstructed catalogue of Leonardo's books, under Literature, Poetry and Fables. Leonardo's wording as rendered there: "the sonnets of Messer Gasparo Visconti".
check_in: Leonardo's autograph book lists: Codex Trivulzianus f. 2r; Codex Atlanticus f. 559r; Madrid Codex II ff. 2v to 3r (which list names this title to be established)

claims.statement: Identified in the reconstruction as Sonetti (Gasparo Visconti). The identification of a title in Leonardo's lists with a specific work and edition is an interpretation.
Composition and printing as given in the reconstruction: Composed late 15th century · Printed 1493.
check_in: ISTC (Incunabula Short Title Catalogue) or Edit16 record for the edition
